lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately twelve visible vertical columns, following a grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity white blobs are positioned at the junctions of prominent vertical bands of elevated luminance and subtle horizontal ridges running longitudinally along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance shift from a highlighted superior edge to a shadowed inferior margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters situated within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density pattern of small, high-frequency luminance spots is visible across the posterior edge and lobes of the caudal fin.
